visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long, straight black hair wearing a white off-the-shoulder evening gown with a high slit stands on a large, red-carpeted stage. She holds a silver transverse flute in her hands while performing coordinated rhythmic movements. Behind her, a massive digital backdrop displays Traditional Chinese text and portraits under the bright light of a large crystal chandelier hanging from the ceiling. (2) The performer begins to play the flute while simultaneously executing a series of rhythmic claps against the body of the instrument and her own hands. She maintains a focused facial expression and moves her legs slightly in time with the tempo. The stage is illuminated by a mix of warm indoor lighting and colorful stage spotlights, casting soft shadows on the background. (3) After finishing the musical piece, the woman lowers her flute and performs a gracious bow toward the front of the stage. The camera remains static throughout the performance. The scene transitions to a full-screen illustration of the performer, followed by additional text overlays providing social media search instructions while she is still visible on the stage in the background.

(3) The rhythmic clapping continues in synchronization with the upbeat music, which features a prominent 4/4 electronic drum beat and shimmering synthesized chords. The balance between the live instrument and the pre-recorded track is centered and clear, with no technical distortion present in the signal.
